description: Search for records by name or domain. query: free-text name search (optional). domain: Odoo domain e.g. [["state","=","draft"]] (optional). action_id: scope search to the action's domain. Pass context for search-time behaviour — e.g. {active_test: false} finds archived records, {lang: "fr_FR"} matches and returns display_name in that language. Returns [{id, display_name}] up to limit.
name: search_records
